subject: Re: Request for SLA credit and remediation plan - Novus Health
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novushealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@novushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Latency incident 2026-08-10 — request for SLA credit and action plan

Hi Sofia,

On Monday (2026-08-10) we saw sustained request latency that caused timeouts for several downstream patient-facing workflows between 14:07–14:54 PDT. Our SREs measured 4.8% request failures and median latency increased from 120ms to 2.1s. This breach triggered our internal outage playbook and we incurred remediation costs and an elevated support load.

We need three things from Redwood:
- Confirmation of the underlying root cause and the incident timeline.
- A proposal for an SLA credit or remediation offer to offset the customer impact (we estimate ~$55k in incremental cost to our team).
- A commitment for follow-up mitigations and a proposed SLO covenant amendment if required.

Please treat this as a formal request under the SLA. Procurement will need an accounting-friendly credit line and a short writeup for our compliance team.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Director, Platform Ops
Novus Health

Attachment: incident-summary-20260810.pdf (attached)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Latency incident 2026-08-10 — request for SLA credit and action plan

Team — forwarding Novus' formal SLA request. Key facts:
- Incident window: 2026-08-10 14:07–14:54 PDT (customer telemetry).
- Impact: elevated latency and ~4.8% failures on production route redwood-gpt-large.
- Customer asks for credit + root cause + mitigation plan.

Immediate asks:
1) Marissa — we need the maximum commercial concession range we can offer as goodwill without requiring full exec sign-off (benchmarks: 1 month service credit; up to 20% invoice credit; or custom one-time credit).
2) Karthik — can you confirm whether this deal is within your approval band or if this needs VP/CEO approval? Deal ID ND-2025-07-317.
3) Aditya — please ensure incident summary and our telemetry export are attached for Novus and legal.

I will draft a customer-facing offer once we align internally.

— Sofia
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: slo-uptime-metrics.csv (for internal review)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Latency incident 2026-08-10 — request for SLA credit and action plan

Sofia — thanks for flagging. Commercial options we can present quickly without legal heavy lifting:
- Option A (Goodwill): One calendar month of service credit applied against next invoice (preferred for speed).
- Option B (Monetary): One-time credit equivalent to 20% of July invoice (cap at $40k) with T&Cs via credit memo.
- Option C (Hybrid): 50% discount on next month + $10k one-time credit.

For anything above $40k or with contract amendments we will need exec approval. We should also offer a mitigation deliverable (1:1 postmortem and prioritized infra work) to close the loop.

I will prepare the credit memo template and accounting code; Aditya, please confirm we can process a $40k memo against ND-2025-07-317.

— Marissa
Head, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: goodwill-credit-template.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Latency incident 2026-08-10 — request for SLA credit and action plan

Sofia / Marissa — I reviewed the incident summary and the commercial history for Novus. This is a high-touch strategic account (multi-year, full-platform purchase). Approval guidance:
- I can approve up to $60k in remediation credit and up to one complimentary billing month. Anything above requires VP/CEO notification.
- Prefer the one-month service credit + $25k monetary credit (keeps goodwill strong and preserves renewal economics).

Please draft the customer communication with clear next steps, and include an offer expiration (seven business days). If Procurement pushes for a larger monetary number, escalate to me and I will take to the execs.

— Karthik
VP, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Latency incident 2026-08-10 — request for SLA credit and action plan

Added the telemetry export and confirmed accounting flow. Notes:
- Telemetry export: attached (slo-uptime-metrics.csv) shows spike at 14:12–14:45 PDT with 95th percentile at ~2.3s.
- Finance: we can issue a credit memo for $25,000 against ND-2025-07-317 and apply a one-month service credit on the September invoice. For anything larger than $60,000, we need finance sign-off and a journal entry.
- Suggested claim text for customer: "As a gesture of goodwill we will apply one month of service credit plus a $25,000 one-time account credit; detailed incident report attached. Offer expires 2026-08-20."

Attachment: slo-uptime-metrics.csv

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@novushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Latency incident 2026-08-10 — proposal for remediation and credit

Hi Elaine,

Thank you again for the detailed report and patience while we reviewed the incident. We are deeply sorry for the impact on your workflows. Below is our proposed remediation and commercial offer:

Summary of offer:
- One month of service credit applied to your September 2026 invoice (account-level).
- One-time account credit of $25,000 issued as a credit memo against ND-2025-07-317.
- A prioritized postmortem and mitigation plan: our infra team will deliver a written RCA and a mitigation roadmap by 2026-08-20, and schedule a 60-minute 1:1 postmortem call the following week.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the above by replying to this thread.
2) Once confirmed we will issue the credit memo and share the RCA.
3) If you need an alternative commercial structure (larger monetary credit or contract amendment), please reply and we will escalate to Karthik for exec review.

Offer expiry: 2026-08-20.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: incident-summary-20260810.pdf (redacted for customer)
